notes: Values are supplied by the primary project authors in processed_data.csv, including author-computed d and p columns; no extractor conversion. Table sample N is preserved under its explicit column name and is not assumed to be analytic n. Narrative success not inferred from coded success columns. Study/sample/test matching requires linked report or paper confirmation. Li report prints Welch t(31.997)=-1.4368, p=0.1605 and d=-0.3866647, whereas primary authors’ processed table supplies derived d/p from MSE2 values. Table d/p are retained together as authorized author-derived values; they are not the report’s Welch test. Table replication_N=37 is not silently substituted with the report effect-size row n1=50/n2=22.
